units: <cite ref="Nedarim 91b:3">Ned. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּרְטֵיה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00264"><he>הוּצָא</he> I</cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q01049"><he>פָּרִיט</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="Q01802"><he>פְּרִיטָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>פְּרִיטִין</he>; <cite ref="Q01802"><he>פְּרִיטָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דפריטן שפוותיה וכ׳</he> Ms. R. a. Ar. (Ms. M. <he>דפריט׳</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>דפְרִיטָה</he>; ed. <he>דפרטיה</he>, corr. acc.) he saw that his (R. Kahana’s) lips were parted, and thought he was laughing at him.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:7">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>דפַרְטִינָן חטאיה וכ׳</he> that we must specify his offence in a public proclamation.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah, Petichta 7">Lam. R. to II, 10</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="Q02043"><he>פְּרַת</he></cite>.
